title: ASCII table chart
alt: ASCII table chart: all 128 ASCII codes in four blocks of 32, with decimal, hexadecimal and 7-bit binary values, the printable characters and the 33 control character abbreviations

title: Binary alphabet chart
alt: Binary alphabet chart: the letters A to Z and a to z and the digits 0 to 9 as 8-bit binary ASCII codes with their decimal values, from A = 01000001 (65)

title: Hex to decimal chart
alt: Hex to decimal conversion chart: a 16 by 16 grid of every two-digit hexadecimal value from 00 to FF with its decimal equivalent from 0 to 255, rows by first hex digit and columns by second

title: Logic symbols chart
alt: Logic symbols chart: the connectives ¬ negation, ∧ conjunction, ∨ disjunction, ⊕ exclusive or, → conditional (implication), ↔ biconditional with how to read them, other notations and their truth tables, plus ⊤, ⊥, ∴, ≡, ⊨ and ⊢

title: Rules of inference chart
alt: Rules of inference chart: the premises and conclusion of 10 valid rules, modus ponens, modus tollens, hypothetical syllogism, disjunctive syllogism, addition, simplification, conjunction, resolution, constructive dilemma, destructive dilemma, and 3 invalid fallacies such as affirming the consequent

title: Logical equivalences chart
alt: Logical equivalences chart: 34 equivalences each checked by truth table, including identity, domination, De Morgan's, distributive, absorption, material implication, contraposition, exportation and the biconditional laws

title: Conditional statements chart
alt: Conditional statements chart: the conditional p → q, its converse, inverse and contrapositive in symbols with their truth table, showing conditional ≡ contrapositive and converse ≡ inverse

title: Set operations Venn diagram chart
alt: Set operations Venn diagram chart: eight shaded two-set Venn diagrams for A ∪ B, A ∩ B, A − B, B − A, A Δ B, A′, (A ∪ B)′, (A ∩ B)′, each with its name and boolean logic equivalent

title: Set notation symbols chart
alt: Set notation symbols chart: 18 set theory symbols including ∈ ∉ ⊆ ⊂ ⊇ ∪ ∩ A′ A − B Δ ∅ with their names, how to read them and a worked example on A = {1, 2, 3, 4} and B = {3, 4, 5, 6}

title: IEEE 754 floating point format chart
alt: IEEE 754 floating point format chart: bit layouts of 32-bit single precision (1 sign, 8 exponent, 23 fraction bits, bias 127) and 64-bit double precision (1 sign, 11 exponent, 52 fraction bits, bias 1023), the value formula, the ranges, and 5.75 worked through as 40B80000

title: Base64 alphabet chart
alt: Base64 alphabet chart: the index table of all 64 Base64 characters, A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, + and /, with each 6-bit binary value, plus how = padding works and the URL-safe alphabet
